headline: Oil production outlook remains resilient

highlights: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating Accumulate Accumulate Target Price 494 512 Sales (INR bn) 309 313 309 319 % Chng. - (1.9) EBITDA (INR bn) 130 131 132 135 % Chng.
Management expects to maintain its quarterly oil production run rate of ~1.0mmt, translating into ~4.0mmt in FY27, with an expectation to increase to 4.2-4.3mmt in FY28/FY29.
Gas production is expected to remain at similar levels in FY27, with further growth relying on evacuation infrastructure.
Higher oil volumes and realizations drive YoY growth: Net sales stood at INR80.7bn, in line with our est.
